items.title: Soap Jessicas Wonderful Life ( Oct 29, 1980)
items.description: One of the Soap retrospectives. This is a recap of season three where Jessica pleads with her guardian angel to allow her to rejoin her family on Earth.

items.title: Soap Who Killed Peter ( Aug 31, 1978)
items.description: A Soap retrospective aired Aug. 31, 1978 between season 1 and 2. Jessica is in jail for the crime and Burt comes to visit her and discuss the case. The show is comprised of clips from season one. (Very Rare)
